== English errata comparison sources ==
Decipher added face-up placement to the Reserve Deck insertion. The November 1998 entry gives the complete game text. Later Players Committee faces reproduce that wording.

Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf#page=3|Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, PDF page 3, Access Denied.
